info.name: Sulabha Candidate Search API
info.description:
CandidateSearchAPI endpoints. JSON is snake_case. Requests chain through collection variables: Extract resume text -> Suggest / Save; List candidates or Search -> candidate detail / delete.

File uploads point at the sample resumes under Tests/ - set Postman's working directory (Settings > General) to the repository folder.

The Admin folder deletes data.

variable.value: Tests/Candidate Resumes for Tests/Anil Sharma - Senior Python Developer.pdf

request.description: Text of a PDF/DOC/DOCX for review; duplicate_of is set when the same resume text is already on file. 400 when no text can be read (scanned image).
AI-suggested form values from the resume text (run Extract resume text first). 502 when the AI service gives none.

Saves one candidate (run Extract resume text first). candidate_id is chosen by the client; the same email or phone as an existing candidate updates that candidate. Isha-specific fields are entered by hand only.
